Managed IT Services for Tampa Bay Businesses

GigitekAI provides enterprise-grade managed IT support, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and AI automation to businesses across Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, and the greater Tampa Bay area.

Unlike national IT providers, we combine enterprise-grade technology with local expertise and personalized service.

Headquartered in Tampa, FL — we understand the local business landscape and can provide on-site support when needed.

Local presence means faster response. Our 99.9% uptime SLA ensures your business stays operational.
